channels.name: A-line / B-line (RS-485 differential pair)
channels.purpose: PROFIBUS-DP differential NRZ telegram data; shared bus.

channels.name: VP (+5 V) / DGND
channels.purpose: Powers the active 220 ohm termination network (390 ohm pull-up/pull-down).

channels.name: MBP bus (PROFIBUS-PA)
channels.purpose: Bus-powered Manchester signal (data + DC supply) at 31.25 kbit/s; intrinsically safe.

global_signals.name: Token
global_signals.purpose: Right to transmit; passed (SD4) among masters in a logical ring.

global_signals.name: Station address (0..126)
global_signals.purpose: Identifies each station in DA/SA; 127 = broadcast.

global_signals.name: Service Access Point (DSAP/SSAP)
global_signals.purpose: Selects the DP service at sender/receiver.

handshake_pairs.name: Token pass
handshake_pairs.rule: SD4 passes the token in ascending station-address order.

handshake_pairs.name: Poll / response
handshake_pairs.rule: Request telegram -> slave responds within TSL (or SC short ACK).

dependency_graph.common_rule: Only the token holder transmits; a master must hold the token before polling slaves, and a slave must be parameterized (Set_Prm) and configured (Chk_Cfg) before it joins cyclic Data_Exchange.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A cyclic Data_Exchange telegram requires: (1) the master holding the token, (2) the slave in the Data_Exchange state, (3) a response within the slot time (TSL). Each telegram is FCS-checked.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Bus idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: No telegram; termination holds the defined idle level between transmissions.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Telegram active
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: A station transmits a telegram (token holder or polled slave).

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: RS-485 differential NRZ, 11-bit UART characters (LSB first), even parity per character.
ordering_rules.telegram_order: Telegrams are framed SD..FCS..ED; SD2 repeats the length (LE/LEr) and the SD2 byte for robustness.
ordering_rules.token_order: Token passes in ascending station-address order; the highest master wraps to the lowest.
